notes:
Summary: Account progressed to procurement after 3-week POC (document redaction + supervised classification). POC met latency and accuracy targets, but final security sign-off failed. Stalled in November 2025: security team insisted on FINRA attestation and full on-prem appliance with HSMs. Customer quote: "We can't accept hosted or VPC variants until legal gets FINRA sign-off — that's non-negotiable."

Key points:
- Primary workload: supervised document classification + real-time compliance chat for trade surveillance (high PII/transactional data).
- POC results: 98.2% classification recall on flagged transactions; avg 120ms p50 latency in dedicated pool (good).
- Deployment ask: on-prem or air-gapped private with KMS/HSM integration and audit log retention 7 years.
- Security/legal requested FINRA-specific control framework evidence and continuous audit attestation; Redwood did not have pre-approved FINRA artifact.
- Procurement timeline slipped when VP of Compliance (internal sponsor) moved roles; no replacement champion identified.
- CFO paused new infra spend (budget freeze) while enterprise consolidates vendor stack for FY26.

Interactions/quotes:
- 2025-10-22 call (ff_78a2b1cde): "If you can deliver a FINRA attestation and HSM-backed key management we can re-open procurement." — Head of Legal.
- 2025-11-05 email thread (gt_20250403_northstar_procurement): Security: "Hosted API is a non-starter for primary trade surveillance. Need full telemetry and custody controls."

Why lost now:
- RivalAI provided a formal FINRA readiness package and contract language within two weeks; Northstar chose them for faster go/no-go.
- Redwood's documentation gap around FINRA was the decisive factor despite strong POC metrics.

Notes for AE/SE/RevOps:
- Capture exact FINRA controls requested (we have some notes in drive:/security/finra_qna_northstar.docx).
- Recommend building a short FINRA readiness checklist and pre-approved contract language.
- Re-engagement play: wait for VP replacement, target Q3 FY26 after vendor consolidation, offer pilot with on-prem proof of custody/HSM integration.
